author: gobernment
body:
NOTE: This is in no way a priority. It's a little feature that can be done in some free time (cc @javipepe)
NOTE: This is probably for Atlas.

Since apparently the number one problem (according to staff spotlights) is "what does this rank do?" from players, I'm proposing a command that is just /ranks. This will prevent these questions by simply referring the user to the command, and having it will answer any questions that the player has about our ranking system. This is done in Cardinal, and I'd like it here, making it a lot easier on people.



Once doing the command, it would display all of the current ranks on the server. These are the ones currently on the staff page, so I'll use these as an example. It looks more organized with the black-circle bullet point, (●), so I'd like to stay using that.

What about localization?
This is easy to translate, actually. The roles have typically always been the same unless someone would want to readd the manager rank, but in that case it shouldn't take more than a week for it to be implemented. It can pull from the translation place for these additions, and we have a team dedicated just for that (ran by Posideon, I believe.)

Would this overlap with our current ranking programs?
Nope, we use the website now to promote users.

How would the information display?
Well, we could go with the /rank info command, or you could hover over the text and it gives the definition. However, I believe one of the developers did not like the hover-over method, so just doing an extra command to see what a rank is shouldn't be an inconvinence. Let's say, when running the command, it can look like this:



Ultimately, it's up to the developers. But, something like this would be a great addition to the network.

I used command blocks to make this suggestion: here's all of the commands I used. edit as you need to see it in action in-game.
 » /tellraw @a {"text":"» Officials run tournaments & leagues that keep the server competitive, as well as manage the referees/media.","color":"gray"}
 » /tellraw @a {"text":"● Official","color":"dark_aqua","bold":"true"}
 » /tellraw @a {"text":"● Official","color":"dark_aqua"}
 » /tellraw @a {"text":"Do /rank info <rank> for info on each rank.","color":"red"}

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body: Really nice command, but unless we get another bot announcement in chat, new players would never know and would still go off to the staff to ask, and I do hope if this does get added (It's a great idea btw, but some flaws) then I hope that staff member does not tell them to just do /rank because that would be the one way you kill the server.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body: Easier just to get the staff member to tell them the /ranks command rather than explain each rank. What's wrong with it? It is more elaborate anyway, considering most mods will just say for instance the mod rank, "they moderate". The moderator description would be able to tell more about the rank.
